purpose: Test acquisition, degradation robustness, and training-set saturation separately

disease_augmentation_ablation.degradation_sampling: Independent of disease label; source, label and quality cross-strata monitored

initial_parameter_grid_not_clinically_va.spatial_illumination: Smooth retinal-mask-bound vignetting or shadow; calibrate on real paired development images

disease_augmentation_ablation.label_policy: Disease loss only when source label is reliable and optic disc remains assessable. Unassessable images retain diagnosis metadata but use rejection evaluation, not ordinary supervised disease loss.
disease_augmentation_ablation.quality_target_policy: Never reuse original-image teacher q or EyeQ human grade after degradation; regenerate targets for exact variant or obtain new quality labels.
disease_augmentation_ablation.evaluation: All arms share held-out clean, real mild/moderate poor-quality, and unassessable groups. Synthetic paired stress results are separately reported and cluster-resampled by parent image/patient.
disease_augmentation_ablation.checkpoint_selection: Predeclared source-specific/macro performance and calibration constraints on model validation; final epochs kept distinct from selected checkpoints

source_class_sampler_ablation.alternative: Weights proportional to inverse square root of source-class count, normalized globally; monitor realized source-class counts, patient repetitions, and calibration
source_class_sampler_ablation.reason: Current sampler repeats each of 213 ODIR positives about 8.10 times per epoch and each of 3608 AIROGS positives about 0.478 times

learning_curve.unit: known patient / linked image group; retain source and diagnosis strata
learning_curve.selection_rule_proposed: Choose smaller training size only if development confidence interval excludes >0.01 AUROC loss and >0.02 sensitivity loss at predeclared specificity, with no material real-poor-quality deficit
learning_curve.optimization_budget: Common maximum optimizer-step budget and validation cadence; report actual steps and best checkpoint. Fractions remain distinct-patient/image counts, not augmented-file counts.
learning_curve.test_policy: Existing trained images may be used for cross-fitted development of a new from-initialization model, but never relabeled as an untouched test of existing weights

new_data_allocation.known_patient_sources: If author splits permit, source-stratified group allocation 60% train / 10% model validation / 10% rule development / 20% held-out test; counts are subject to positive-case precision requirements
new_data_allocation.unknown_patient_sources: Internal model/rule validation may use the jointly audited image-association groups, explicitly labeled image-group validation rather than patient-independent validation. Independent external testing requires entire source-family holdout.
new_data_allocation.related_hospital_sources: LAG/GRAPE share a hospital; confirmed GRAPE-FIVES, FIVES-FundusAVSeg and FIVES-MSHF associations connect five sources. Allocate them jointly by known patient/confirmed image groups for training and internal validation, never as mutually independent external cohorts.
new_data_allocation.source_holdout: Keep at least one full new source for evaluation before any model-performance inspection; keep existing ACRIMA and HYGD external roles
new_data_allocation.evaluation_positive_targets: Aim for roughly 200 independent positives in the main clinically compatible validation/test cohort and enrich real low-quality positives. This supports about +/-3 percentage-point precision near 95% sensitivity under an independent binomial approximation, not paired-comparison power.
new_data_allocation.paired_comparison_power: Estimate discordant automatic-FN probabilities on development only and calculate paired power; do not derive it from total image count or AUC alone
